author: PokerFace
body:
Hi, I made a map.

Features:
  • Iron
  • 2 obsidian monuments
  • 2 wool rooms
  • Elevators (Yes they do work like a real one)
  • Arrow spawners in middle [Will do ASAP]
  • Archery areas
  • Underground tunnel/sewage area.
Team Size: 25v25

Pictures: https://imgur.com/a/r0r12

replies.author: KroestV2
replies.body:
A 1-5 height difference spread out over the complete map does not impact gameplay. Giving something more depth when you are designing something, mc related or not, is one of the key things to make something look good.

It does not have impact on how easy a map is to understand.

replies.body: If something is ugly or not always depends on personal preference, but giving something you designed depth is one of the key factors to make something look good.

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
I sort of agree with Kroest, a slight height difference would be a welcome thing and Avicus' maps tend to make it too easy for people. The maps have very little variation from one another which makes people too used to flat maps.

It has even gotten to the extent that people were confused on where to go on my map and where the monuments were.

Hargrove's Shape:



"Hargrove". To see this... it really puts into perspective how little Avicus players really know about creative maps. Truly.

But the "Ugly" comment was sort of... much?

I like the map and think that the edition of an "Elevator" is really awesome but add some diversity to height a bit.
